Gordon the gorilla and Phil the bear are all alone in space, orbiting Jupiter. Phil works in a lab on Ganymede, while Gordon is stuck in a space station far above. When Gordon's glory rod - a portal device that lets you slide yourself into anyone across the galaxy, beeps and tells him that there's a new user nearby, that can only mean one thing:
Working with Phil is about to get a lot more fun!
